originalTitle: Who are the investors ready to jump on Anthropic?
summary: The BBC's Samira Hussain speaks to a retail investor eagerly waiting for the AI company's stock to go live on Thursday.
content:
Anthropic will make its stock market debut on Thursday, poised to hit a value of more than $1.4 trillion (£1.1 trillion).

The BBC’s Samira Hussain spoke to a retail investor looking to capitalise on the AI revolution. Could Anthropic's stock market debut signal the start of a wave of AI companies going public?
chineseTitle: 谁是准备加入 Anthropic 的投资者？
chineseSummary: 英国广播公司 (BBC) 的萨米拉·侯赛因 (Samira Hussain) 与一位急切等待这家人工智能公司股票周四上市的散户投资者交谈。
chineseContent:
Anthropic 将于周四在股市首次亮相，市值有望突破 1.4 万亿美元（1.1 万亿英镑）。

BBC 的萨米拉·侯赛因 (Samira Hussain) 采访了一位希望利用人工智能革命的散户投资者。 Anthropic的上市是否预示着人工智能公司上市浪潮的开始？
